notablePrerequisites: You control at least two enchantments.
description:
Activate Serra's Sanctum by tapping it, adding at least {W}{W}.
Activate Deserted Temple's second ability by paying {1} and tapping it, targeting itself.
Locus of Enlightenment triggers, copying Deserted Temple's ability, targeting Serra's Sanctum.
Resolve both Deserted Temple abilities, untapping it and Serra's Sanctum.
Repeat.

uses.name: The Enigma Jewel // Locus of Enlightenment
uses.cardState: on the battlefield as Locus of Enlightenment
